natural_body: Price-sensitive SMBs: 40% off drove signup +31%, revenue +18%, retention -12%.

first.rationale: I would verify the strongest evidence for shortening onboarding and in-product activation messaging, given the simultaneous declines in onboarding completion and activation. I currently intend to simplify onboarding because it directly addresses the measurable completion problem and has previously improved time-to-value and early adoption. I would use a guarded standard experiment with qualified activation and downstream revenue-quality guardrails, rather than optimize for completion alone. Promotional pricing is less attractive for the sustainable-revenue objective because prior discounting increased signups and revenue but reduced retention.
